fields.title: Conclusion
fields.md:
1. One-sentence conclusion: The 3Q26 13F (posted 2026-11-16) shows a quarter in which, among the five large holdings, only Bank of America was cut by 5.7% while the rest (Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola, Alphabet) were left unchanged, and the amounts trimmed from banks and VeriSign were added to Lennar, Delta and Bending Spoons — probabilities of 25/50/25 and the assumed value band are unchanged (source: [3Q fact sheet](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/60471.xml) · Section 5).
2. Briefing in 5 lines
   - Berkshire 3Q26 13F posted (2026-11-16): 30 issues/classes, total $304.197 billion ([13F](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/xslForm13F_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
   - Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola and Alphabet share counts unchanged · Bank of America −27.53 million shares (−5.7%, calculated) ([fact sheet](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/60471.xml)).
   - Reduced: Capital One −61.7% · VeriSign −34.1% · Nucor −14.9% · Kroger −10.3% / Increased: Lennar A +98.6% · Delta +12.4%, Bending Spoons new $689 million (calculated, same source).
   - Top-5 holdings concentration 65% (9/30, 66% at end of June) — milestone D-2030-1 (≤75%) remains on track ([10-Q R14](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R14.htm)).
   - Rules R1–R6 not met — scenarios 25/50/25 and assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 maintained · Class B 11/16 close $592.85 ([stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)).
3. Three data points to check directly before the next issue
   - Bending Spoons ownership stake and acquisition cost — 4Q26 10-K equity note or tier-1 press reports (T5, [3Q fact sheet](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/60471.xml)).
   - Composition of the roughly $31.3 billion of equities outside the 13F (calculated 335,515 − 304,197) — fair value of the Japanese trading house stakes (10-K equity note, [10-Q R14](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R14.htm)).
   - Yen bond settlement (2026-11-19) and the ¥73.4 billion maturity repayment (2026-11-27) — 4Q26 10-K debt note (T2, [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452592/d86634d424b5.htm)).
